summary: Iteration 3 (new features) — both backend and frontend tested. Backend 14/14 pytest passed including content CRUD (pricing + portfolio multipart upload + /api/files serve + soft delete + bad-ext 400 + auth 401), alerts (unseen counter, mark-seen, PATCH sets seen, alerts_status={email:false,in_app:true}), look upload+fetch, and end-to-end transcribe with real espeak-ng speech sample — Whisper transcript + GPT extraction correctly returned name containing 'Priya' and date == '2027-02-14'. Frontend flows all passed on desktop 1920x1080: admin login → tabs, unseen badge appears after seeded enquiry, mark-seen clears badge, alerts-note visible; PricingEditor add/edit/delete works and rows persist; PortfolioEditor multipart upload creates a portfolio-admin-item whose loads (naturalWidth=500) from /api/files/... , edit-caption saves, soft delete removes item; landing Portfolio grid renders 9 items from API and Pricing section loads. Try-On flow: sample → generate AI (single generation, ~20s) → studio-ai-image visible → look-gallery shows 1 gallery-item → clicking gallery restores AI view → studio-book-btn uploads look and scrolls to contact where contact-look-chip 'Bridal Classic' + contact-look-thumb with /api/files/ src appear → contact form submits → contact-success → admin API confirms enquiry persisted with look_image starting /api/files/. Voice enquiry: mic permission granted, voice-start-btn → voice-stop-btn appears with 'Say your name…' hint; after ~3s stop, backend responded 422 (silent audio) and frontend showed a graceful toast 'We couldn't hear anything — please try again closer to the mic' within ~5s (no hang, no uncaught error). Regression: desktop overflow=0, mobile 390x844 has minor 5px horizontal overflow.

issues: Minor 5px horizontal overflow on mobile viewport — inspect hero or marquee sections. Desktop is clean (0px).
Event date still uses native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than shadcn DatePicker (carry-over from iter 1/2).

action_items: (Low) Investigate 5px horizontal overflow on mobile (390 width) — likely a section using min-w or negative margin.
(Carry-over) Replace native date input with shadcn DatePicker in Contact.jsx.
Optional: filter MediaPipe INFO log emitted via console.error to reduce noise (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: content.py store_image path uses uuid + ext but does NOT validate the file content is really an image (relies on extension only). Consider magic-byte sniffing (imghdr / Pillow) to reject renamed .txt→.jpg uploads (currently .txt is rejected because it isn't in MIME map, but a text file renamed .jpg would pass).
enquiries.py unseen count uses {seen: {$ne: True}} which correctly includes legacy docs without 'seen' field. Works as documented in review request.

studio.py transcribe: EXTRACT_SYSTEM prompt is solid; JSON extraction with regex could fail on markdown code fences — consider stripping ```json fences before json.loads. Currently handled by try/except fallback so not critical.

alerts.py send_enquiry_alert: look_image URL check uses .startswith('http') so /api/files/... won't embed in email (email is skipped anyway without key). If email is enabled later, prepend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for /api/files/ URLs.
content.py create_pricing/portfolio uses count as 'order'; after deletions counts can collide — non-critical since UI sorts by order asc and only used for display.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed enquiries/pricing/portfolio and clean them up in the same run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 features validated end-to-end. Real speech transcription tested using espeak-ng (apt-installed). Only cosmetic follow-ups remain: 5px mobile overflow + native date picker. Use http://localhost:8001 for pytest, https://vibe-finder-76.preview.emergentagent.com for Playwright.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. The 5px mobile overflow is a layout artefact (likely negative margin / min-w on a section); not blocking.
